main_text.head: IN COLLOQVII, VEL FABVLÆ POTIVS BADENSIS, XX. Nouembris anno 1589. actæ, binos histriones, Iohannem Piftorium fide Apostata, professione medicu: Et Iacobu Andreā fabellum Neftorieutychianæ Vbiquitatis fabrū, & Pfeudapoftolum.
main_text.p: Onstituere duo lites componere sacras, Perfidus hinc Pistor, pessimus inde faber.
Scilicet hi poterūt lites componere sacras, Ille deos pinsens, iste deos fabricans.
Ille quidem crustum ceu verum numen adorans, Corporeum hic fabricans, qui sit vbique, Deum.
At tu pistores procul, & procul exige fabros, Verus, Christe, Deus: ceu quoque verus homo.
main_text.head: IN EOSDEM.
main_text.p: Bini Badensis histriones fabulæ, Pistor, patris propago degener optimi, Crustaceorum impure pistor numinum, Papæ ruentis putre fustentaculum, Non digne turpem basies cuius pedem, Sed digne figas cuius ofculanatibus.

page.notes: The first word of the title reads "IN COLLOQVII", with the Q and a long tail; the two-line verse block near the top was set in italic with underlined sections; the initial "B" is a large woodcut initial with "ini" following; "Tot" at the foot right is the catchword-like fragment, likely the start of the next page; "Bini" and "Pistor" and other words in the poem are italic with the Greek-style accent on "sit"; the page's running head is absent. Doubtful readings: "sacras" and "Pistor" in the poem; "Iacobu" in the title block; "cuius" lines; "Neftorieutychianæ" possibly "Neftorianæ-Eutychianæ"; "Papæ ruentis" possibly "Papæ ruentis"; "Vbiquitatis" standard. Lines of the stanza "Bini Badensis" may be misaligned with the printed verse order.
